# dsh-Context-Drawer
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin with exactly **one** job:
> When the conversation context reaches a threshold (default **50%** of the model window), move olde
r messages into a **folder associated with that conversation**, then release the oldest finished tur
ns from the model-visible context.
There is no UI, no button, no route, no memory bridge, no prompt injection. The chat transcript and
the append-only session log are never modified — the released part is only invisible to the model, a
nd the archive on disk always has it.
## Behaviour
- Every turn, at the first step, the plugin estimates context usage (real provider usage when availa

ble, character estimate otherwise).
- When usage reaches `thresholdRatio` (default `0.5`) of the mod

el window:
1. Append the messages newer than the last archive watermark to `{archiveDir}/{sessionSho

rt}/{date}.md`, fsync first;
2. Only after the file is safely on disk, remove the oldest **finished*

* turns from the model-visible context with a surface `replace` event.
The latest `keepRecentTurns`
(default 6) turns are never touched, at most `releaseMaxTurns` (default 40) per pass, stopping near

`releaseTargetRatio` (default 0.45).
- Session log and transcript remain complete; the archive file

is plain Markdown you can open at any time.
- State lives in `~/.dsh/context-drawer/state/state.json
` (one watermark per session, prevents duplicates).
## Where the files go
Default: `~/上下文存档/{sessionShort}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.md`
`sessionShort` is the session id with the `session-` prefix removed, first 8 characters — one subfol
der per conversation, so you can always tell which conversation a file belongs to.

## 中文说明
只做一件事：上下文占用到达阈值（默认 50%）时，把更早的对话追加进「跟这个会话关联的外部文件夹」，落盘之后再把最旧的已结束轮次从模型可见上下文里移走。没有界面、没有按钮、不写记忆、不碰聊天记录原文。
默认存档位置 `~/上下文存档/{会话短号}/{日期}.md`，一个会话一个文件夹；状态在 `~/.dsh/context-drawer/state/state.json`。最近 6 轮永远保留，单次
上下文存档/{会话短号}/{日期}.md`，一个会话一个文件夹；状态在 `~/.dsh/context-drawer/state/state.json`。最近 6 轮永远保留，单次最多释放 40 轮。
